newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Corp takes stakes in Australian oil fields.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Corp takes stakes in Australian oil fields.

text.p: Mitsubishi Corp said on Monday that it had acquired equity stakes of between 7.5 percent and 20 percent in three offshore oil fields in northwestern Australia.
Mitsubishi's wholly owned subsidiary Diamond Gas Resources Pty Ltd acquired 20 percent in the Leatherback Farmin Area and 7.5 percent each in the EP342 and TP/9 fields.
It plans to begin exploring the oil fields in November, a spokesman for the trading company said, adding that the total development costs are estimated at about 10 billion yen.
The areas are estimated to have reserves of about 150 million barrels of crude oil, the spokesman said.
The operator of the oil fields is Apache Corp.
Mitsubishi plans to drill exploratory wells by the end of the year, and begin commercial production as early as 1999.
